sql: SELECT "Track"."TrackId" AS k, (CAST("Track"."Bytes" AS REAL) / "Track"."Milliseconds") AS m1 FROM "Track" WHERE (CAST("Track"."Bytes" AS REAL) / "Track"."Milliseconds") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: Track.track file size per track length
why: track file size / track length: the catalogue declares track file size a rate over track length
rank Track rows by track file size per track length
